name: Shuri

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Critical Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Oyundaki tüm temel vuruşları temassız olan tek şampiyon — çoğu şampiyon siperleyip sersemletemez. Temassız vuruş siperleyen ve vacilo önleyen şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
Vibranium Aegis
Against Special Attacks, Shuri can block Unblockable attacks and has [0 - 5]% Perfect Block chance for each of her personal Armor Up Passives.
immunityDetails:
• Şok Bağışıklığı ⚡️
• Buff Bağışıklığı (sadece isabet buff'ına bağışık) 🗡️🚫
• Yetenek Doğruluğu Azaltma Bağışıklığı 🧠❇️

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Shuri's adaptive technology ensures her Ability Accuracy cannot be altered, and grants her immunity to Shock and Precision effects that are not her own.
Shuri cannot land Critical Hits without her personal Precisions.
Shuri's attacks are non-contact and deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.

abilitySections.title: Kinetic Matrix - Max Charges: 10
content: Gain an indefinite Matrix Charge when struck or when Blocking attacks (5 on a Well-Timed Block). Lose 3 charges when struck by True Damage.
At max charges, new Matrix Charges become Armor Up Passives, increasing Armor Rating by [305.56] for 1 second, expiring 1 at a time. Max Armor Ups: 20.

abilitySections.title: Light and Medium Attacks
content: Consume 1 Matrix Charge to inflict a Shock Debuff dealing [2,215.62] Energy Damage over 22 seconds. Max stacks: 50.
Shocks inflicted with Critical Hits become Critical Shock Passives, multiplying their Energy Damage by Shuri's Critical Damage Multiplier. Max stacks: 50.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: On Heavy Charge, consume 10 Matrix Charges to gain a 100% Untouchable Passive for 5 seconds.
On Heavy Hit, refresh any active Shock effects on the Opponent and consume any personal Precision Passives to convert that many active personal Shock Debuffs into Critical Shock Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: On hit, refresh any active Shock effects and pause them for the duration of the Special Attack.
Predictive targeting AI ensures Shuri's Special Attacks cannot be Evaded.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit grants Shuri a Matrix Charge and an indefinite Precision Passive, plus an extra Precision for every 10 Shock Debuffs the Opponent is suffering.
These do not count as Precisions and are consumed by Light and Medium hits to become Guaranteed Critical Hits.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a Shock Debuff for each Critical Shock the Opponent is suffering, each dealing [2,215.62] Energy Damage over 22 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Deal a burst of [3,776.63] Direct Damage for each Shock and Critical Shock effect the Opponent is suffering.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Vibranium Aegis
content: Against Special Attacks, Shuri can block Unblockable attacks and has [0 - 5]% Perfect Block chance for each of her personal Armor Up Passives.
